articles.title: Claude AI Flaw Lets Malicious Browser Extensions Execute Commands on Remote Computers
articles.summary:

Researchers at Forever Security named the attack ThisBash. They found that Claude Dispatch accepted instructions from an ordinary logged-in claude.ai session.
